summary: Completed frontend-only runtime verification against the public preview in Chromium: 24/26 grouped checks passed. Two confirmed UI bugs; no backend/auth/model integration is in scope. Application source files were not modified.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing motion on OR off silently replaces the rendered puzzle canvas with a transparent 300x150 canvas. Initially it is 720x720 with populated pixels; after either toggle all alpha values are zero. Auto levels or changing threshold/plate restores it.

At 320px the menu button extends beyond the right viewport edge: x285..321 in dark, x288..324 in light. The header loses its right padding and the menu circle clips. Menu remains operable; 768/1024/1440 and main content have no detected horizontal overflow.

action_items: Redraw the puzzle canvas when its DOM instance is recreated by a motion toggle, or prevent Reveal from replacing the canvas subtree.
Reduce or adapt the header control footprint/padding at 320px in both themes.
Rerun the two saved regression scripts after changes; retain real MediaRecorder and explicit local-only save/download behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Reveal.jsx switches its wrapper between motion.div and div when motionOn changes, remounting child DOM. SecretLayer.jsx drawing effect depends only on threshold/status/plateIdx, so the new canvas is never drawn until one of those changes. Confirmed using pixel data, not just visibility.
Nav.jsx fixed control widths, gaps and padding exceed the available 320px header inner width; overflow-x-clip hides the excess rather than fixing the layout.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No authentication or credentials; #/setup is an unlisted local editor, not an authenticated account.
seed_data_creation: Only disposable isolated browser contexts and TEST_ WAV/transcript fixtures; no database or production data. Tested reset and discarded browser contexts. Explicit fixture exports remain under test_reports/runtime.

fixes: Stable Reveal motion.div retains the canvas subtree during motion toggles
Compact mobile theme button and adapted header spacing retain right padding at 320px
post_fix_verification.results: Main agent reran both testing-agent scripts in foreground: portfolio_runtime.py 19/19 PASS; portfolio_edges.py 7/7 PASS. Final build also passed.
post_fix_verification.canvas: 720x720, alpha sum 132192000 before and after both toggle directions
post_fix_verification.mobile_header: 320px dark and light: menu bounds x259..295, no clipped controls or horizontal overflow
post_fix_verification.scope: Chromium; real MediaRecorder with synthetic input. No physical microphone, Safari/Firefox or full accessibility audit. Initial issue lists above retained as historical findings, now resolved.

rca of the issue: Canvas: load public page, confirm 720x720 populated canvas, toggle motion, inspect canvas -> 300x150 transparent; toggle back -> still transparent; Auto levels -> 720x720 populated. Root cause is Reveal subtree remount combined with unchanged draw-effect dependencies. Header: set viewport 320, inspect nav-menu-btn bounds in dark/light; right edge 321/324 exceeds 320. Fixed-width controls plus gaps/padding cause excess width masked by overflow clipping. Initial harness-only failures (uppercase tag text, async save timing, immediate print color transition, scroll clamping at final section, platform telemetry categorization) were corrected and retested; these are not application defects.
